$comment: L08 decision 12. A story skips one gate check only with a `gate-skip-<check>` tag AND an entry here: { story, check, rules (axe only: the rule ids it hides), reason (an ADR or issue), expires (YYYY-MM-DD) }. A tag without an entry, an entry without a tag, and an expired entry all fail the gate. L10 decision 6: a component may also release with a stale manual run through { component, check: "stale-run", sourceHash (the fingerprint it was reviewed at; any later edit voids it), reason, expires }, checked by scripts/check-a11y-contracts.mjs.

exceptions.reason: axe-core 4.14 reports the sticky title of a scrolling dialog as partially obscured, naming no obscuring element; the title is topmost at every sampled point once animations finish (L08 probe, 2026-10-27, scope-decisions § L08). Its colours are fg.default on bg.raised, a pair the L01 token build checks in both themes. Only incomplete contrast is hidden; a contrast violation still fails.

Same as components-dialog--fullscreen: axe-core 4.14 can't compute the contrast of a sticky title in a scrolling dialog and names no obscuring element (L08 probe, 2026-10-27). fg.default on bg.raised is checked by the L01 token build. Only incomplete contrast is hidden.
